{{Otheruses|Level 2}}
The '''Energy shield level 2''' was an upgraded version of the basic [[Energy shield level 1|energy shield]]. These units were marketed primarily to companies and governments that kept large standing forces of [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]]. Unfortunately, the power drain during its use was significant, therefore, the units needed to be replaced regularly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
